findings.title: Test the guarded screen's passing outcome
findings.why_it_matters: The new <2°C/<2 s screen can fail to ever report a valid passing coupon while the full R7 test runner remains green. The unit cases exercise indeterminate and outside outcomes; the committed synthetic evaluations also all produce OUTSIDE or INDETERMINATE, so none checks the passing branch or its end-to-end reporting.
evidence: packages/temper-thermal/studies/glass_sensor/revision7/calibration/adapter.rs:167-181: r7_guarded tests assert only INDETERMINATE and OUTSIDE_PROPOSED_SCREEN.
packages/temper-thermal/studies/glass_sensor/revision7/calibration/results/SYNTHETIC-holdout.txt:19-23: r7_error_screen and r7_response_screen are both OUTSIDE_PROPOSED_SCREEN.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a direct r7_guarded case where error plus expanded uncertainty is strictly below 2, and a valid synthetic evaluation whose output asserts both r7_error_screen=WITHIN_PROPOSED_SCREEN and r7_response_screen=WITHIN_PROPOSED_SCREEN.

findings.title: Exercise independent acquisition guards through R7 entry point
findings.why_it_matters: The required fit/holdout isolation can regress without a failing R7 test. The only scripted rejection changes the pan ID, so r7_identity_pair rejects before the new run ID, raw origin, and identical raw-byte checks execute; the unit tests likewise call only r7_identity_pair.
evidence: packages/temper-thermal/studies/glass_sensor/revision7/calibration/adapter.rs:92:     if m["run_id"] == hm["run_id"] || m["raw_origin"] == hm["raw_origin"] || fit_hash == hold_hash {
packages/temper-thermal/studies/glass_sensor/revision7/calibration/run.sh:42-46: the sole scripted lineage rejection changes pan_id and checks for the earlier whole-pan holdout error.
packages/temper-thermal/studies/glass_sensor/revision7/calibration/adapter.rs:117-181: R7 unit tests exercise identity_pair and guarded arithmetic, but never run_r7's acquisition guard.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend calibration/run.sh with three otherwise valid fit/holdout pairs that separately reuse run_id, reuse raw_origin, and reuse identical CSV bytes while keeping pan and configuration identities distinct; assert each exits nonzero with the independent-acquisition error.
